# F.A.M.s Mobile Catering

> Family-run mobile catering in Surrey, UK, since 2021. Weddings, private parties, corporate events and special occasions, cooked fresh and served from our own black-and-gold catering van. Motto: "Creating memories".

F.A.M.s is a family business; the name is the family's initials (Florin, Alexandra, Mirela, Sofia). We cover Surrey and surrounding areas, and further afield by arrangement. Quotes are tailored to each event; there are no fixed packages.

- Email: fams.company2021@gmail.com
